scope: Jurisdiction-level traveler consumption-tax policy only; this does not establish Rolex retailer participation, an individual purchaser's eligibility, or a guaranteed refund amount.

sources.publisher: Agenzia delle Dogane e dei Monopoli
sources.title: OTELLO - The procedure

observedFacts: VAT direct relief or refund is available for qualifying personal or family-use goods when each invoice exceeds EUR 70 and the traveler resides or is domiciled outside the EU.
The goods must leave the EU within the third month after the invoice date, with customs endorsement of the tax-free invoice.
The refund is made by the Italian seller or a tax-free company acting for that seller; a service fee may be deducted.
limitations: The source does not establish that every retailer participates in the tax-free process.
Rolex retailer participation and any transaction-specific refund amount are not established by this evidence.
